title: Will We Really Want 100 Corgi Cafes?
summary: Corgi Cafe—and Corgi’s hope to open so many more—underscore several broad truths about AI. Venture capitalists have thrown huge amounts of money to AI startups, allowing companies like Corgi to contemplate things like opening cafes.
